review_notes: Existing recovered code readability only; no new native coverage. 42 exact local-token substitutions and 20 structured edits. Retain generic_suspend_legacy control flow and labels; its changes are mechanically checked local renames. One combined incremental build, with full audits, inventories and reccmp deferred.

Time Spiral: preserve shared Sliver leaves-play, absent-source activation and cleanup handling, humiliation queries, ability-specific targeting and callback order. Simplify suspend setup and Clockspinning event dispatch while preserving AI predicates. Preserve Ib Halfheart two-sacrifice selection, fizzle propagation, unmark and kill ordering.

Nemesis: preserve boost/activation event routing, Mana Cache source checks and legacy setup, and live battlefield scans. Pale Moon indexed writes retain the same seven mana-color entries per player and nonbasic-land marking queries.

Portal: simplify target iteration with live number_of_targets reads after callbacks while retaining target selection, cancellation, temporary unmarking and spell destruction. Keep combat-window scans and native color/name predicates under exact local-token substitution.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
